# Layout Examples

布局组件通常组合使用，先确定容器，再选择 Space/Grid/List 等局部排版组件。

每个组件一节，供 MCP `tigercat_component` 按 `## {Component}` 抽取。绑定差异见 `shared/patterns/common.md`。

## Sidebar

Runnable modules: `examples/example/vue3/src/examples/sidebar/` and `examples/example/react/src/examples/sidebar/`.

Note: `collapsedWidth="0px"` 时 `inert` + `aria-hidden`，里面的控件离开 Tab。边框是 `border-inline-end`。未传 `width` 时默认宽走 class。未传名时 landmark 走 locale。内层未传 `collapsed` 的 Menu 跟随侧栏。

Vue: `<Sidebar :collapsed="collapsed">Nav</Sidebar>`

React: `<Sidebar collapsed={collapsed}>Nav</Sidebar>`

Imports: use PascalCase subpaths such as `@expcat/tigercat-vue/Button` and `@expcat/tigercat-react/Button`. Hooks and `notification` use the same subpath rule. Shared types and helpers come from `@expcat/tigercat-core`.
